localContext: Tucson's NDT work splits between aerospace and defence and southern Arizona mining. A missile-systems plant near the airport and its suppliers machine and test precision parts; Davis-Monthan Air Force Base and the 309th Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group bring airframe maintenance; large copper mines and mills need structural, tank and piping inspection. Aerospace leans on PT, MT, ET and UT to customer specifications, mining on VT, MT and UT thickness.
certPathwayNote: Employers certify under a written practice based on ASNT SNT-TC-1A: training hours, logged experience, general, specific and practical examinations, a vision test, then employer certification. Defence and aerospace customers flow down their own requirements, which the employer's Level III reconciles. Arizona radiography needs state radiation licensing, separate from method certification.
